scope: Batch 9 extraction from the untagged 2014-2015 Khans of Tarkir / Fate Reforged / Dragons of Tarkir Magic Story pages. Also the 2018 Chronicle of Bolas pages set on Tarkir. Three timelines appear: the Khans present, Tarkir's past (Fate Reforged) and the rewritten dragonlord present (Dragons of Tarkir). Each leader claim says which. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; targeted, not exhaustive; not owner approved.

claims.subject: surrak

quotes.quote: Perhaps you've seen Surrak Dragonclaw, the khan of the Temur clan.

claims.summary: Surrak Dragonclaw is khan of the Temur (Khans of Tarkir present).

quotes.quote: Narset is the Khan of the Jeskai.
until the elders saw to appoint me the khan of the Jeskai

claims.summary: Narset was appointed khan of the Jeskai by its elders (Khans of Tarkir present).

claims.subject: nicol_bolas

quotes.quote: That dragon, called Bolas, killed Ugin.

claims.subject: nicol_bolas

quotes.quote: I was merely a tool used by a power greater than myself. That dragon, called Bolas, killed Ugin.

claims.summary: Yasova says a voice made her a tool of a greater power, and names Bolas as Ugin's killer.
claims.limitation: She does not say in so many words that the voice was Bolas; the link is from adjacent sentences.

claims.subject: naiva

quotes.quote: Baishya took hold of her elbow as if she thought her twin couldn't take the hint.

claims.summary: Naiva and Baishya are twins of the Atarka tribe.
claims.limitation: That they are Yasova's grandchildren is not established by this quote; they call her 'Grandmother'.
